blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.
blocks.zh: 通过体积磁共振胆兰基蛋白学(MRCP)扫描对主要胰腺管(MPD)进行评估,是进行管状分解诊断和胰腺癌分析的一项基本任务. 然而,人工评估受到读者变化的影响,自动化分析可能对此有所帮助。 然而,从体积多氯二苯并呋喃(MRCP)中进行完全自动化的和对不确定性认识的多氯二苯并呋喃分析,仍然是未得到充分探讨的研究领域。 在这项研究中,我们提议从MRCP扫描中为MPD分解和最大宽度分析提供自动和有不确定性意识的深层学习管道。 一个粗糙的本地化模式首先确定了具有利益的管道区域,然后是将磁共振在区域内分割的精细模式。 数据集由来自69个病人的256个MPD分块MRCP扫描组成. 随机选取的由14名患者组成的持有55个MRCP卷的搁置测试子集用于评价. 我们采用了五种模式的交叉验证组合,以改进业绩和不确定性估计。 最佳的MSD分解性能为:0.634 DSC,0.744精度和0.593回想. 最大 MPD 宽度预测的平均绝对误差为 0.355~mm,放大的 MPD (\geq 5$~mm) 被检测出75.0~%的敏感度和74.4~%的特异性. 这些新颖的结果表明,可以使用自动化的MPD分解来帮助基于MRCP的管道测量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Pancreatic cancer, most commonly pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), is one of the most aggressive cancers worldwide, ranking seventh among cancer-related deaths, with incidence still increasing [ 20 ] . One reason for the poor prognosis is that more than 80 % of patients with PDAC are diagnosed in late stages which is why early detection is critical for improving prognosis, as tumors often become inoperable after infiltrating adjacent structures.
Imaging plays a central role in identification of early disease, including small solid tumors and secondary morphological changes in the pancreatic parenchyma and main pancreatic duct (MPD). Computed tomography (CT) is the main imaging modality used in the diagnosis of PDAC, while magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is used as a problem-solving imaging modality for cases that are not conclusive in CT.
blocks.zh:
胰腺癌,最常见的是胰腺沟渠性腺癌(PDAC),是全球性最强的癌症之一,在癌症相关死亡中排名第七,发病率仍在上升[20]. 预后不良的一个原因是80%以上的PDAC患者在晚期诊断,这也是早期检测对于改善预后至关重要的原因,因为肿瘤在渗入相邻结构后往往无法运作。
成像在早期疾病的识别中起着中心作用,包括小固态肿瘤和胰腺瘤和主胰腺管(MPD)的二次形态变化. 计算成型成像法(CT)是诊断PDAC时使用的主要成像模式,而磁共振成像法(MRI)则作为解问题成像模式,用于CT中没有定论的病例.

blocks.en:
The main reason for this is that MRI provides a higher sensitivity for detecting small ( < 2 <2 cm) isodense lesions compared to CT [ 6 ] . Another main advantage of MRI is the
ability to obtain images of the ducts by magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP). MRCP imaging is based on heavily T2-weighted pulse sequences and thus highlights the natural differences in T2-weighted contrast between fluid-filled structures such as
ducts and surrounding soft tissues [ 10 ] . The MRCP is one of the imaging sequences taken routinely during abdominal MRI [ 12 ] .
In addition to an expansive tumour finding, imaging findings may be secondary [ 4 ] . The most common of these is dilatation of the main pancreatic duct [ 15 , 22 ] which can be associated with an obstructing tumour that causes
focal stricture with dilatation upstream, and the stricture is usually abrupt in morphology and over
6 mm long in malignant cases [ 16 ] . Changes in MPD can be detected in MRCP images [ 10 ] .

能够通过磁共振的cholangiopancreatographic(MRCP)来获取管道的图像. MRCP成像基于重力T2加权脉冲序列,从而凸显了T2加权结构之间的自然差异,如:
管道和周围软组织 [10]. MRCP是腹部核磁共振过程中常规拍摄的成像序列之一[12].
除了扩大的肿瘤发现外,成像发现可能是次要的[4]. 其中最常见的是主胰腺管的分化[15,22],它可能与引起肿瘤的阻塞有关.
焦距与上游的分化, 且在形态学和超度上, 节度通常是突然的
恶性病例6毫米长[16]. MPD的变化可以在MRCP图像中检测到[10].

blocks.en:
In their study Toshima et al. [ 22 ] concluded that most patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma showed focal pancreatic abnormalities on CT performed at least 1 year before diagnosis. The focal change in MPD diameter exhibited the shortest duration from its development to subsequent diagnosis [ 22 ] . Hence, it is important to develop tools to maximise the acquisition of information about the morphology of the main duct.
Moreover, the volume and diameter of MPD as features have been shown to improve the classification performance of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma compared to using only radiomics features [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
在他们的研究中,Toshima et al. [22]结论认为,大多数胰腺沟渠性腺瘤患者在诊断前至少1年的CT上表现出焦性胰腺异常. 磁共振直径的焦距变化显示了从发展到随后诊断最短的时间[22]。 因此,必须开发工具,最大限度地获取关于主要管道形态的信息。
此外,MPD作为特征的体积和直径被证明可以改善胰腺管性腺瘤的分类性能,而仅使用放射特征[23].

blocks.en: Deep learning has been extensively applied in the field of medical image analysis, including a variety of tasks such as semantic segmentation, image to image enhancement, and classification. In medical image segmentation, U-net [ 17 ] , i.e., the encoder-decoder architecture with skip connections, has become the standard model architecture. For volumetric segmentation, 3D variants such as 3D U-Net has been proposed [ 7 ] . More recently, complex variants of U-net have been proposed, such as nnU-Net [ 14 ] , which include fully automated preprocessing pipelines and automated architectural choice, such as number of layers and features, and Swin-UNETR [ 11 ] that are still based on the encoder-decoder approach but instead of convolutional layers, it utilises shifted window approach and transformer blocks.
blocks.zh: 深入学习被广泛应用于医学影像分析领域,包括语义分裂,图像到图像增强,分类等多种任务. 在医学图像分割中,U-net [17],即带有跳过连接的编码器-解码器架构,已经成为标准模型架构. 对于批量分割,提出了3D U-Net等3D变体[7]. 最近提出了U-net的复杂变体,如nnU-Net[14],包括全自动预处理管道和自动建筑选择,如层层和特征的数量,以及Swin-UNETR[11],它们仍然以编码器-解码器方法为基础,但与其说是演化层,不如说是采用转向窗口方法和变压器块.

blocks.en:
The segmentation of the main
pancreatic duct using deep learning approaches has previously been studied using CT-based imaging. In the pancreatic domain, so far most automatic analysis of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) has been developed on CT rather than MRCP. Abi Nader et al. [ 1 ] proposed a deep learning pipeline on portal venous CT for pancreatic lesion detection and MPD dilatation assessment. Their method first segmented the pancreas, lesions, and visible MPD using nnU-Net, and then derived imaging features including MPD diameters in the pancreatic
head, body, and tail. In a large multi-institutional cohort, they reported a mean MPD Dice score of 0.58 ± \pm 0.37, showing both the feasibility and difficulty of automatic duct segmentation.
More recently, Tan et al. [ 21 ] studied MPD segmentation on photon-counting CT and reported an average Dice score of 0.621 using nnU-Net. In addition, Ambo et al. [ 2 ] proposed an automated CT-based pipeline for MPD dilatation detection that combined pancreas segmentation, MPD segmentation, centreline estimation, and cross-sectional shape analysis. Together, these studies show that automatic duct analysis is possible, but the literature remains centred on CT.
MPD segmentation has been studied with high resolution, high contrast, and large field-of-view Photon-Counting CT scans using nnU-Net, which was trained using 53 scans and evaluated on 13 scans, resulting in average DSC of 0.621 [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
主机的分割
使用深层学习方法的胰腺管以前曾使用基于CT的成像法进行研究. 在胰腺域中,迄今为止对主胰腺管(MPD)的多数自动分析都是在CT上开发的,而不是MRCP. 阿比·纳德尔等人. [1] 提议在门户阴性CT上进行深度学习,用于胰腺损伤检测和MPD分化评估. 他们的方法首先用nnU-Net对胰腺、损伤和可见的MSD进行分解,然后产生成像特征,包括胰腺中的MSD直径
头、身体和尾巴 在一个庞大的多机构群体中,他们报告一个平均的MPD 虱分0.58±\pm0.37,显示自动胶管分化的可行性和难度.
最近,谭等人. [21]研究了MSD在光子计数CT上的分化,并报告使用nnU-Net的平均Dice分数为0.621. 此外,Ambo等人也表示过. [2] 提出一个基于CT的自动化管道,用于MPD Dilatation检测,将胰腺分化,MPD分化,中线估计,以及交叉形状分析结合起来. 这些研究表明,自动胶管分析是可能的,但文献仍然以CT为中心.
MPD分解研究以高分辨率,高对比度,以及使用nU-Net的大型视场光子调试CT扫描,通过53次扫描培训,13次扫描评价,平均DSC为0.621[21].

blocks.en: In contrast to studies with CT, there are few studies on MPD analysis based on MRCP volumes, largely due to limited availability of 3D MRCP datasets with expert annotation. However, MRCP is clinically important for MPD evaluation due to its high contrast for fluid-filled structures without ionizing radiation. Existing MRCP-based studies in pancreatic imaging are more commonly focused on detection or characterisation of pancreatic cystic lesions, or they rely on manual or semi-automatic duct segmentation, rather than delivering a fully automated 3D MPD segmentation tool [ 19 ] . Beyer et al. [ 3 ] established age-dependent reference values for the diameter of the pancreatic duct in MRCP in a large population dataset, showing that the diameter of the duct increases with age and that conventional upper limits may overestimate abnormality in healthy subjects. Ikezawa et al. [ 13 ] studied the correlation between MPD diameter measurements on special pancreatic ultrasonography and MRCP, again treating MRCP as a measurement reference rather than as an input to automated image analysis. Similarly, Zhang et al. [ 24 ] analysed MPD diameter on MRI to identify malignant intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm, which reinforces the clinical importance of MPD width as a biomarker. Still there is no research work on the fully automated MPD segmentation-width analysis pipeline, the lack of which motivates the need for data-driven MRCP analysis approaches that explicitly address automated MPD width categorized classification.
blocks.zh: 与使用CT进行的研究相比,基于MRCP卷的MPD分析研究很少,主要原因是3D MRCP数据集可用量有限,且附有专家注释. 然而,MRCP在临床上对于MPD评价很重要,因为它对于没有电离辐射的充满流体的结构具有很高的反差. 胰腺成像中现有的基于MRCP的研究更注重于胰腺囊肿的检测或特征化,或者依赖于人工或半自动的胶带分解,而不是提供全自动的3D MPD分解工具[19]. 贝耶等人. [3] 在大型人口数据集中,对MRCP中胰腺管的直径设定了基于年龄的参考值,表明管道的直径随着年龄的增长而增加,常规的上限可能会高估健康主体的异常性. 池泽等. [13]研究了特殊胰腺超声学上MPD直径测量与MRCP的关联性,再次将MRCP作为测量参考,而不是作为自动化图像分析的输入. 同样, 张等. [24]在核磁共振上分析MPD直径,以识别恶性管道内粘膜肿瘤,这强化了MPD宽度作为生物标志的临床重要性. 目前还没有关于完全自动化的MPD分区宽度-宽度分析管道的研究工作,因为缺乏这一管道,所以有必要采用数据驱动的MRCP分析方法,明确处理自动化的MPD分类宽度。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
In this study, we evaluated whether automatic segmentation can support quantitative maximum-width analysis of the main pancreatic duct from 3D MRCP volumes. We adopted established 3D encoder-decoder segmentation models in a task-specific coarse-to-fine pipeline designed for a thin tubular structure. Moreover, uncertainty of the model is quantified, analysed, and compared against its performance to estimate the utility of model uncertainty.
The overall workflow consisted of three steps: (1) full-volume coarse localisation of the MPD region, (2) region-of-interest (ROI) extraction and detailed segmentation using a fine model, and (3) uncertainty estimation using five cross-validation models.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们评价了自动分解是否能够支持从3D MRCP卷对主要胰管进行定量最大宽度分析. 我们采用了一种针对特定任务的粗细至细细管道,为薄薄的管状结构设计的3D编码器-解码器分离模型。 此外,对模型的不确定性进行了量化分析,并与模型的性能进行比较,以估计模型不确定性的效用。
整个工作流程包括三个步骤:(1) MPD 区域全量粗放本地化,(2) 利益区(ROI)利用精细模型进行提取和详细分解,(3) 利用五个交叉验证模型进行不确定性估计.

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset, annotation and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集、注释和预处理

blocks.en:
In this retrospective study, we used 256 MRCP volumes of 69 patients from Tampere University Hospital pancreatic cyst registry. The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki, it was approved and the need for patients’ informed consent was waived by the Institutional Review Board of the Wellbeing Services County of Pirkanmaa, Finland (reference approval number: R24295). The patient records were retrospectively collected and pseudonymised by the data-providing authority prior to transfer to the research environment.
All analyses were performed within a secure and access-controlled Aalto University’s SECDATA computing environment compliant with national data protection policies and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这份回顾性研究中,我们使用了来自坦佩雷大学医院胰腺囊肿登记簿的256份MRCP卷69位患者. 这项研究是根据《赫尔辛基宣言》进行的,并获得批准,芬兰Pirkanmaa福利服务县机构审查委员会免除了患者知情同意的必要性(参考批准号:R24295)。 患者记录在转移到研究环境之前由数据提供当局追溯收集和假名。
所有分析都是在一个安全和无障碍的Aalto大学SEDATA计算环境范围内进行的,符合国家数据保护政策和一般数据保护条例[8]。

blocks.en: Expert voxel-wise MPD segmentations were created in 3D Slicer (version 5.6.2) [ 9 ] primarily by two clinical researchers and after that, two experienced abdominal radiologists with over 20 years of MRI experience reviewed all the segmentation annotations. The annotation protocol focused on the visible main pancreatic duct in the source MRCP volume. Cases with uncertain visibility were reviewed jointly by the two radiologists to improve annotation consistency.
blocks.zh: 在3D Slicer(5.6.2版)[9]中,主要由两名临床研究人员创建了专家的Voxel-wise MPD片段,之后,两名具有20多年核磁共振经验的有经验的腹部放射学家审查了所有的片段说明。 注释协议侧重于来源MRCP卷中可见的主要胰管. 两位放射学家联合审查了能见度不明的案件,以提高注释的一致性。

blocks.en: All MRCP volumes were resampled to a voxel spacing of 0.9 × 0.625 × 0.625 ​ mm 3 0.9\times 0.625\times 0.625\,\mathrm{mm}^{3} and intensity-normalised on a per-volume basis before training.
blocks.zh: 所有MRCP卷均被重印为每卷0.9×0.625×0.625毫米 3 0.9\时0.625\时,\mathrm{mm}^{3},并在训练前按每卷量进行强度正常化.

blocks.en: The dataset was divided at the patient level in the development and test sets with a 80:20 ratio, resulting in 201 and 55 scans, respectively. The characteristics of the dataset are shown in Table 1 . In model training, the development set was further divided into 5-folds, where four folds were used for the training subset and one fold as the validation data for model selection. The test dataset consisted of 55 scans from 14 patients having 1 to 7 scans each, and was used to evaluate the developed methods. In particular, for patients with multiple MRCP scans the test dataset, the mean interval between the earliest and latest scan was 2.89 years, with a standard deviation of 1.47 years. In the patients with multiple scans, each of the scans was taken at different time points.
blocks.zh: 数据集在开发和测试集中以80:20的比例在患者层面进行划分,结果分别进行了201次和55次扫描. 数据集的特征见表1。 在模型培训中,开发集被进一步分为5倍,其中4倍用于培训子集,1倍用作模型选择的验证数据. 测试数据集由14个患者的55个扫描组成,每个患者有1至7个扫描,并被用于评价所开发的方法. 特别是,对于有多个MRCP扫描测试数据集的患者来说,最早扫描和最新扫描之间的平均间隔为2.89年,标准偏差为1.47年. 在多次扫描的患者中,每次扫描都是在不同的时间点进行.

blocks.en: Table 1: Characteristics of Development and Test Datasets. In our dataset, main pancreatic duct (MPD) dilation is caused by MPD Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm (IPMN) or mix type IPMN.
blocks.zh: 表1:开发和测试数据集的特点。 在我们的数据集中,主要的胰腺管(MPD)膨胀是由MPD内膜帕皮菌(IPMN)或混合型IPMN引起的.

blocks.en: Each input MRCP volume was denoted by x ∈ ℝ 1 × D × H × W x\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times D\times H\times W} , where D D , H H , and W W denoted the depth, height, and width of the 3D MRCP volume. The corresponding expert annotation is a binary label map y ∈ { 0 , 1 } D × H × W y\in\{0,1\}^{D\times H\times W} , where y ⁡ ( v ) = 1 y(v)=1 indicates MPD and y ⁡ ( v ) = 0 y(v)=0 indicates background. The MPD is a tubular structure with varying width, and in terms of the imaged MRCP volume, only consists of a small fraction of the full MRCP volume ( 0.019 % 0.019\% ). Therefore, a direct segmentation approach is affected by a severe class imbalance. Instead, we adopt a coarse-to-fine strategy: a coarse model first localises a high-recall candidate MPD region, and a fine model then performs detailed segmentation inside the cropped full resolution ROI.

H×W x\in\ mathbb{R}^{1\times D\times H\Times W},其中DD,HH,WW表示3D MRCP卷的深度,高度和宽度. 相应的专家注释是二进制标签地图y {{0,1}D × H × W y\in {0,1}D\times H\times W},其中y → (v) = 1 y(v)= 1表示MPD和y → (v) = 0 y(v) = 0表示背景. MPD是一个宽度不一的管状结构,就成像的MRCP体积而言,它只包含全部MRCP体积的一小部分(0.019 % 0.019 % ) 。 因此,一种直接的分化方法受到严重的类不平衡的影响。 相反,我们采取了粗细的策略:粗细的模型首先将高召候考生的MPD区域定位,精细的模型然后在收割的完全分辨率ROI内进行详细的分解.

blocks.en: 2.2 Segmentation models
blocks.zh: 2.2 分离模型

blocks.en: We evaluated established 3D segmentation models rather than proposing a new backbone architecture. The purpose of the model comparison was to identify a reliable and feasible model for MPD segmentation and downstream maximum-width estimation from 3D MRCP. The final selected model used a 3D U-Net as the coarse localisation model and a 3D SegResNet as the fine segmentation model.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了三维分离模式,而不是提出新的骨干结构。 模型比较的目的是确定一个可靠和可行的模型,用于从3D MRCP中分解和下游最大宽度估计。 最终选择的模型使用3D U-Net作为粗细的本地化模型,以及3D SegResNet作为精细的分区化模型.

blocks.en: Model selection criteria include: (1) practical training and inference GPU memory demand, (2) stable convergence on the collected dataset, (3) segmentation performance on validation set.
blocks.zh: 模型选择标准包括:(1)实用培训和推论GPU内存需求,(2)所采集数据集的稳定趋同,(3)在验证集上的分解性能.

blocks.en: A 3D U-Net [ 7 ] was used as a convolutional encoder–decoder baseline from MONAI, and selected as the coarse localisation model with full 3D MRCP image volumes as input. The model was implemented using the MONAI UNet module [ 5 ] and the input and output channels were adapted to single-channel MRCP input and binary MPD segmentation.
blocks.zh: 3D U-Net [7] 被用作MONAI的转录编码器–解码器基线,并被选为粗版本地化模型,以完整的3D MRCP图像卷作为输入. 该模型使用MONAI UNet模块[5]实施,投入和输出通道被调整为单通道的MRCP输入和二进制MPD分割.

blocks.en: Swin UNETR [ 11 ] was used as a transformer-based volumetric segmentation baseline from MONAI with SwinUNETR backbone from MONAI [ 5 ] . We used the sliding window input shape of 64 × 64 × 64 64\times 64\times 64 , embedding dimension 12, depths ( 1 , 1 , 2 , 1 ) (1,1,2,1) , and attention heads ( 3 , 6 , 12 , 24 ) (3,6,12,24) . The input and output channels were adapted to single-channel MRCP input and binary MPD segmentation. No task-specific architectural modifications were introduced.
blocks.zh: Swin UNETR [11]被用作MONAI的基于变压器的量子分解基线,其中SwinUNETR主干线来自MONAI [5]. 我们使用了64×64×64 64\time 64\time 64,嵌入维度12,深度(1,1,2,1,2,1)和注意力头(3,6,12,24). 输入和输出通道被改造为单通道的MRCP输入和二进制的MPD分割. 没有针对具体任务的建筑改造。

blocks.en: DynUNet [ 5 ] is a dynamic UNet model heavily based on nnU-Net [ 14 ] , which was selected as a self-configuring medical image segmentation pipeline. We used DynUNet from MONAI with the 3D full-resolution configuration. The framework automatically determined the patch size, batch size, network topology, and training schedule from the training data.

blocks.en: The proposed pipeline included two stages, where the first stage includes a coarse 3D U-Net segmentation model that receives a full MRCP volume at four-times downsampled spatial resolution with the goal of approximate localisation of the MPD duct with near-perfect recall. This additional stage is important because the MPD occupies a very small fraction of the full image volume, making direct full-resolution segmentation inefficient and highly imbalanced. The data sample is defined as: x c = 𝒟 ⁡ ( x ) x^{c}=\mathscr{D}(x) , where x c ∈ ℝ 1 × D c × H c × W c x^{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times D_{c}\times H_{c}\times W_{c}} and p c = f θ c ​ ( x c ) p^{c}=f_{\theta_{c}}(x^{c}) , and the prediction is defined as: p c ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 1 × D c × H c × W c p^{c}\in[0,1]^{1\times D_{c}\times H_{c}\times W_{c}} . Given a downsampled MRCP volume, the coarse 3D U-Net predicts a binary MPD segmentation map over the whole 3D image volume. The segmentation prediction on the downsampled 3D image volume is then used to crop the region of interest, defined as: x roi = 𝒞 ⁡ ( x , b ) x_{\mathrm{roi}}=\mathscr{C}(x,b) , where x roi ∈ ℝ 1 × d × h × w x_{\mathrm{roi}}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times d\times h\times w} . To avoid missing potential duct voxels during the ROI cropping stage, the ROI is spatially expanded by a fixed safety margin in all directions. In practice, we set the safety margin to 10. The resulting bounding box is used to crop a full-resolution ROI from the original MRCP volume ROI expanded with a safety margin. In this way, the fine model receives an input that is much smaller than the full scan but still contains the full MPD region with sufficient surrounding context.

Since the search space had already been reduced by the coarse localisation stage, the fine model could focus on detailed MPD boundary delineation instead of global duct detection. During inference, this ROI-level prediction is mapped back to the original image space using the crop coordinates obtained from the coarse stage, yielding the final full-volume segmentation result.

To improve model calibration, we trained an ensemble of five coarse-to-fine model pairs using five-fold cross-validation on the development set. Model performance on unseen data was evaluated using a test that was not used during any of the model development. During inference, the five trained coarse-to-fine models were applied independently to each test case producing five independent prediction masks. blocks.en: The test was independently reviewed by two abdominal radiologists. For each case, the readers recorded the maximum MPD width from the reference segmentation and from the model prediction. The readers also assigned a visual quality score to the prediction of the model and to the original MRCP images using a five-point Likert scale and provided reasoning for the grading. The Likert for model prediction are as follows: 1: Poor (not clinically usable at all), 2: Low, some usable parts mostly not usable (large errors, fine details do not matter), 3: Medium, many usable parts but some parts problematic (fine details missing), 4: Good, almost fully usable, some minor issues, 5: Perfect, fully usable, no major or minor issues. The Likert for the MRCP image quality are defined as follows: 1. Very poor, 2. Poor, 3. Fair, 4. Good, 5. Excellent.

MRCP图像质量的Irikrt定义如下: 1. 非常贫穷, 2. 穷人, 3. 公平, 4. 不错, 5. 不错。

The cases were divided into two groups using a maximum-width threshold of 5 ​ mm 5\,\mathrm{mm} : non-dilated MPD ( < 5 ​ mm <5\,\mathrm{mm} ) and dilated MPD ( ≥ 5 ​ mm \geq 5\,\mathrm{mm} ). using MAE and accuracy metrics.

blocks.en: The utility of the model uncertainty by the model was evaluated using referral-based analysis and correlation analysis. In the referral-based analysis, each sample is ordered by an uncertainty measure and then removed from the dataset for expert referral. The mean qualitative and quantitative performances of the remainder is then calculated, producing a lineplot of expected fully-automated performance if a proportion of the data is referred. We evaluate the referral from 100% to 30%, as the noise in the results at the lower count of samples increases considerably. In correlation analysis, quantitative measures are directly compared to an uncertainty measure in a scatterplot, and a linear regression model is fitted to show the correlation coefficient and statistical significance. In addition, two radiologists’ mean values for each of the quantitative measures are evaluated against an uncertainty measure using boxplots for each of their ordinal categories, which can be visually evaluated for correlation. Moreover, we calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient ( r r ) when comparing the uncertainty measure and the segmentation metrics, and the Spearman rank correlation coefficient ( ρ \rho ), when comparing the uncertainty measure and qualitative metrics.
blocks.zh: 利用参考分析和相关性分析评估了模型不确定性的效用。 在基于转诊的分析中,每个样本都根据不确定性措施排序,然后从专家转诊的数据集中删除。 然后计算其余部分的平均质量和数量性能,如果提到一部分数据,则产生一个完全自动化的预期性能线程图。 我们评估转诊率从100%到30%,因为样本数量较低的结果中的噪音大大增加。 在关联性分析中,定量度量直接与散点中的不确定性度量比较,并安装了线性回归模型,以显示相关系数和统计意义. 此外,对每个定量计量的两名放射学家的平均值进行对照不确定性计量值的评价,对每一类放射学家的正数类别都采用方块,可视同评价其相关性。 此外,我们在比较不确定度量和分量度时计算出皮尔逊相关系数(r r r ),在比较不确定度量和定性度量时计算出斯皮尔曼级相关系数(à\rho ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Segmentation performance
blocks.zh: 3.1 分离性能

blocks.en: The segmentation performance was evaluated and reported for both coarse and fine models with a more detailed analysis of the final segmentation performance of the fine models.
blocks.zh: 对粗细模型和细细模型的分解性能进行了评价和报告,并对细细模型的最后分解性能进行了更详细的分析。

blocks.en: 3D U-Net achieved near-perfect ROI recall as the coarse model, which means that nearly all of the reference MPD voxels were included within the cropped region of interest. The ROI cropping reduced the spatial size of the input for the fine segmentation stage by approximately four-fold compared with the full MRCP volume, while preserving basically full MPD coverage.
blocks.zh: 3D U-Net实现了近乎完美的ROI召回作为粗细模型,这意味着几乎所有参考的MPD voxels都包含在所关心的收割区域. 与MRCP的全部体积相比,ROI的裁剪将细分化阶段的输入空间大小减少了约4倍,同时基本上保留了MPD的全部覆盖.

blocks.en:
Within the coarse-to-fine framework, three fine-stage segmentation models were evaluated: 3D U-Net, Swin UNETR, and 3D SegResNet, in addition to which
the DynUNet was included as a one-stage full-volume reference pipeline. Table 2 summarised the MPD segmentation performance on the test set with all four evaluated pipelines. The 3D U-Net + 3D SegResNet approach turned out to have the highest Dice similarity coefficient, precision, recall among the compared methods. These results suggest that ROI-based coarse-to-fine segmentation pipeline is well suited for MPD segmentation due to the fact the duct is a small tubular structure that occupies only a small fraction of the full MRCP volume.
blocks.zh:
在粗细至细细的框架中,评价了三个精细的分层模式:3D U-Net、Swin UNETR和3D SegResNet。
DynUNet作为单阶段的全量参考管道被列入。 表2汇总了所有四个经评价的输油管在试验装置上的磁性能。 3D U-Net + 3D SegResNet的方法在比较方法中最终具有最高的Dice相似系数,精度,召回. 这些结果表明,基于ROI的粗对细分化管道非常适合MPD分化,因为管道是一个小管状结构,只占MRCP整体容积的一小部分.

blocks.en: 3.2 Qualitative evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 定性评价

blocks.en:
In this subsection,

我们报告所有质量评估措施。

blocks.en:
The MPD Max width was qualitatively measured from the segmentation model prediction and ground truth by the two radiologists using 3D Slicer. The MPD was considered dilated if the maximum width is ≥ 5 \geq 5 mm. The consensus of the two radiologist was defined by taking the mean of their evaluated width values. In terms of model performance compared
to ground truth, the mean absolute error was 0.355 mm. This resulted in a dilated MPD accuracy of 74.5%, with a sensitivity of 75.0%, a specificity of 74.4%, a precision of 45.0% and an F1-score of 56.3%. For the ground truth annotations, the inter-rater agreement between the two radiologists was 0.618 mm MAE and the accuracy of the classification of DMPD was 83.6%.

Focusing only on the best-performing model (3D U-Net + 3D SegResNet) and evaluating referral performance with the three uncertainty measures (CV, SH, and H), the initial performance at 100% data was 0.634 DSC. The mean DSC at 60% data remaining was 0.718 (CV), 0.699 (SH), and 0.644 (H). At 30% data remaining, the DSC values were 0.730 (CV), 0.677 (SH), and 0.665 (H). blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
In terms of segmentation performance, the 3D U-Net + 3D SegResNet approach outperformed all other methods due to its residual convolutional feature extraction mechanism, which can provide stable optimization and better preservation of local ductal boundary information on a limited dataset. However, our approach did produce a single empty prediction mask and had the second lowest ASSD value of the compared methods. The only transformer
based approach, i.e., Swin UNETR, had the lowest performance out of all compared methods. This can likely be attributed to the relatively small
amount of data for the transformer-based approach.

blocks.en: In the downstream task of MPD max width estimation and dilated MPD classification from deep learning-based segmentation masks, the automatic approach achieved good performance, though still with lower value than the inter-rater agreement, which is consistent with the segmentation metrics thus having room for improvement. The sensitivity indicates that most of the dilated cases were detected, while the relatively low precision reflects false-positive dilatation predictions. These results suggest that the model-derived maximum width may be useful for screening or prioritisation, but false-positive cases would still require review by a radiologist.
blocks.zh: 在MPD最大宽度估计的下游任务中,从深层基于学习的分解口罩放大了MPD的分类,自动方法取得了良好的性能,尽管其价值仍然低于与分解度量一致的分解协议,因此有改进的余地. 灵敏度表明,大部分膨胀病例被检测出来,而相对较低的精度则反映了假阳性分化预测. 这些结果表明,模型产生的最大宽度可能有助于筛选或确定优先顺序,但假阳性病例仍需放射科医生审查。

blocks.en: In qualitative analysis, the mean visual evaluation of the clinical usability of the prediction of the model using the Likert grade was 2.67 by the first radiologist and 2.50 by the second radiologists. This indicates that the predicted segmentations were often imperfect as complete anatomical masks. However, the sub-millimeter maximum-width error suggests that the method may still be useful as a measurement-support tool, especially when the intended endpoint is maximum MPD width rather than complete duct delineation. An important finding was that the prediction errors did not exhibit a readily identifiable pattern. In a single case, the model failed to detect MPD completely, producing a clinically misleading measurement, and it occasionally produced subtle and visually conspicuous ductal abnormalities, and some predictions extended outside the ductal lumen. This suggests that the performance of the model was not solely determined by the apparent complexity of the finding. One possible explanation is A shift in data distribution between training and validation datasets, including variations in anatomy, imaging protocols, or image quality, which may have affected model generalisability. This heterogeneity of failure modes complicates the identification of a single technical explanation and highlights the need for further investigation into the factors that could affect model robustness. Moreover, when comparing both segmentation quality and MRCP image quality Likert values to model performance, a visual relationship is evident for segmentation measures, but less clear for MPD max width estimation.
blocks.zh: 在定性分析中,使用Ikrt等级对模型预测的临床可用性进行的平均视觉评价是第一位放射学家2.67,第二位放射学家2.50. 这表明,预测的分解往往不完美,因为是完整的解剖口罩。 然而,子毫米最大width误差表明,该方法作为测量支持工具可能仍然有用,特别是当预期终点是最大MPD宽度而不是完整的管道划界时. 一个重要的结论是,预测错误没有表现出易于识别的模式。 在一个案例中,模型未能完全检测到MPD,产生了临床误导性的测量,偶尔会产生微妙和视觉明显的胶质异常,一些预测延伸到胶质流体之外. 这表明,该模型的性能并非完全取决于调查结果的明显复杂性。 一种可能的解释是,培训和验证数据集之间的数据分布发生转变,包括解剖学、成像协议或图像质量的变化,这可能影响到模型的通用性。 故障模式的这种异质性使单一技术解释的确定复杂化,并突出表明需要进一步研究可能影响模型稳健性的因素。 此外,在将分解质量和MRCP图像质量对比成模型性能时,视觉关系对于分解度量是显而易见的,但对MPD最大宽度估计则不太清楚.

blocks.en: In the uncertainty analysis, UNet 3D + SegResNet3D had the highest performance in terms of referral-based analysis. In terms of uncertainty measures, the coefficient of variation measure outperformed the two entropy-based uncertainty measures, which is consistent with previous work in medical image segmentation [ 18 ] . The correlation analysis demonstrated that uncertainty can estimate segmentation quality. The boxplots show visual ordinal relationships between CV and qualitative measures. In terms of DMPD classification, the model had 74.5% accuracy, which is lower but relatively close to the inter-observer variability, where the raters had 83.6% agreement, setting a realistic upper bound for the model performance.
blocks.zh: 在不确定性分析中,UNet 3D + SegResNet3D在基于推荐分析方面的性能最高. 在不确定性度量法方面,变异度量的系数超过了两个基于肽的不确定性度量法,这与以前在医学图像分解[18]中的工作是一致的. 相关分析表明,不确定性可以估计分化质量。 箱型显示CV和质度度度量之间的视觉正文关系. 在DMPD分类方面,该模型有74.5%的精度,该精度较低,但相对接近观测者之间的可变性,其中测率者有83.6%的协议,为模型性能设定了现实的上限.

blocks.en:
There are limitations in our study related to the number of cases studied and the tools for qualitative measurement. The number of individual patients and the number of image volumes were relatively low; there are 14 patients with 55 scans included in the test set. However, the average duration between scans was nearly three years, providing more heterogeneous cases even from the same patients with generalizability.
In addition, the data were from a single hospital, which may reduce the generalizability of the results.
The reference measurements were obtained using the native measurement tool provided by 3D Slicer. As measurement markers partially obscure the duct margins during placement, exact identification of the measurement endpoints is inherently limited by image resolution and observer judgment. Therefore, a small degree of measurement uncertainty should be assumed when interpreting the reported distances. This partially explains the disagreement between the two raters.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究在所研究的案件数量和定性衡量工具方面存在局限性。 个人患者人数和图像卷数相对较低;有14名患者在测试集中包含55个扫描. 然而,扫描之间的平均持续时间将近3年,即使同一患者的扫描范围比较广泛,也使病例更为多样。
此外,数据来自一家医院,这可能会降低结果的通用性。
参考测量是利用3D Slicer提供的本土测量工具进行的。 由于测量标记部分模糊了放置时的管道边距,准确识别测量终点必然受到图像分辨率和观察者判断的限制. 因此,在解释所报告的距离时,应假定有一定程度的测量不确定性。 这在一定程度上解释了两个评分者之间的分歧.

blocks.en:
Future work should focus on external validation across institutions and hospitals, as the current study is based on a single hospital. Furthermore,
the collected dataset should scale up to improve generalizability. Methodologically, future models should improve MPD continuity, reduce zero-prediction cases, and better preserve the MPD morphology. In addition, more robust automatic width-estimation methods, such as orthogonal cross-sectional analysis, is expected to reduce dependence on manual expert measurement.
blocks.zh:
今后的工作应侧重于跨机构和医院的外部验证,因为目前的研究是以单一医院为基础的。 还有,
所收集的数据集应扩大范围,以提高通用性。 从方法上讲,未来的模型应提高磁共振的连续性,减少零预测性病例,更好地保存磁共振的形态。 此外,更坚固的自动宽度估计方法,如正交截面分析,预计将减少对人工专家测量的依赖.

blocks.en:
This study demonstrates the feasibility of automated segmentation of the main pancreatic duct from 3D MRCP using convolutional neural networks. Although segmentation of the duct remains challenging due to the MPD occupying only a small fraction of the image volume and its irregular morphology, the proposed pipeline supports a quantitative assessment of its maximum-width. Ensemble-based uncertainty analysis showed a clear correlation between higher model uncertainty and lower segmentation performance, indicating that uncertainty estimates may help identify cases that require radiologist review.
Expert validation further suggested that MRCP image quality is related to maximum-width measurement reliability, with lower image-quality scores associated with higher MPD max width measurement errors. Overall, the method shows potential as a support tool for MPD width assessment, but further external validation and robustness improvements are needed before clinical deployment.
blocks.zh:
本研究论证了利用进化神经网络从3D MRCP中自动分解主要胰管的可行性. 虽然由于MPD只占据图像体积的一小部分及其不规则形态,管道的分割仍然具有挑战性,但拟议的管道支持对其最大宽度进行定量评估. 基于组合的不确定性分析显示,较高的模型不确定性与较低的分解性能之间有明显的关联,表明不确定性估计数可能有助于确定需要放射学家审查的案例.
专家论证进一步提出,MRCP图像质量与最大宽度测量可靠性相关,图像质量分数较低与MPD最大宽度测量误差较高相关. 总体而言,该方法显示有可能成为MPD宽度评估的支持工具,但在临床部署前需要进一步的外部验证和强健性改进.

blocks.en: Data availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: The patient data cannot be shared publicly because of the data protection law of Finland, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of European Union, and our research permission granted by Tampere University Hospital that do not allow sharing of individual patients’ data. The patient data is available from Tampere University Hospital for researchers who meet the criteria for access to confidential data. More specifically the datasets are not publicly available and restrictions apply to their use. The dataset restrictions are imposed by the Wellbeing Services County of Pirkanmaa, Tampere University Hospital, Research services, P.O. Box 2000, 33521 Tampere, Finland (requests for the data access can be made to clinicaltrials@pirha.fi).
blocks.zh: 由于芬兰的数据保护法、欧盟的数据保护总条例(GDPR)以及坦佩雷大学医院授予的不允许分享个人数据的研究许可,患者数据无法公开分享。 坦佩雷大学医院向符合获取机密数据标准的研究人员提供患者数据。 更具体地说,数据集没有公开提供,而且对其使用有限制。 数据集限制是由芬兰坦佩雷市坦佩雷大学医院Pirkanmaa福利服务县提供的研究服务,2000年,P.O.Box,33521 Tampere(可请求临床审判员@pirha.fi查阅数据)。

blocks.en: Code Availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: The code used for data processing, deep learning algorithms, and model evaluation is not publicly available. The Methods section provides sufficient detail for replication using open-source libraries. Code is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
